name: tracer
description: Code intelligence for Claude Code: every file Claude reads, edits, or searches arrives with its declarations, its callers, its git history, and the project docs it has not read yet.

tracerOnly.title: Claude reads files only through tracer
tracerOnly.description: Claude can't read, search, or list files with grep, cat, ls, find, or git blame when tracer gives the same answer. It uses tracer instead, so every read comes with what tracer knows about the file.
